purpose: Popover-backed menu surface that hosts dropdown-item rows and owns arrow-key, Home, End, and Escape navigation.
useWhen: Rendering the floating panel that holds a dropdown's menu items.
Composing a dropdown's body from dropdown-item, dropdown-label, and dropdown-separator children.

avoidWhen.reason: Used outside a dropdown context — it requires the dropdown provider and will throw otherwise.
Showing arbitrary non-menu content — use popover.
